# sa'nsayaw

> Metro Manila dance class schedule aggregator. Updated daily.

sa'nsayaw (sansayaw.org) lists open drop-in dance classes from studios across Metro Manila, Philippines. The schedule is scraped automatically every morning and covers the next 7–14 days.

## Studios covered

- **ZERØ Studio** (Quezon City & Mandaluyong) — hip hop, K-pop cover, heels, femme, breaking, open choreography
- **The Playground Studios** (San Juan, Metro Manila) — open choreography, K-pop cover, femme, collab classes
- **Nude Floor** (Manila) — dancehall, femme, fitness
- **808 Studio** (BGC/Taguig & The Podium, Ortigas) — 808 Signature, 808 Step, 808 Originals, 808 Cover

## Data

- Schedule data is scraped daily from each studio's public booking/calendar page
- Each class entry includes: date, time (PHT), instructor, class name, genre/style, venue
- No user data is collected beyond standard web analytics

## Contact

For questions or to add a studio: see the About page at https://www.sansayaw.org
